display_information.name: Kanbo
display_information.description: Add tasks to Kanbo from Slack: /kanbo, any message, and link previews.
display_information.long_description: Kanbo for Slack lets your team capture work where it's discussed. Type /kanbo and the task in your own words ("Send the brief fri 3pm #launch @sana") and Kanbo reads the date, time, project and person just like Quick capture. On any message, choose More actions › Create a Kanbo task to turn it into a task with a link back to the message. Kanbo task and project links you paste show a preview with Complete and Open buttons. Everyone links their own Kanbo account first, and Kanbo always acts with that person's own access.

shortcuts.name: Create a Kanbo task
shortcuts.description: Turn this message into a Kanbo task
